standard.title: SA — Start Application
standard.prompt: SA means Start Application. When I say SA <tool>, start that terminal tool (never open a webpage unless I ask). Available tools include: blackeye (token CLI), ellofive api, ellofive ubuntu, ellofive agents. Confirm the tool, the exact CLI command, and run it if you have a shell.

catalog.title: Start Blackeye CLI
catalog.prompt: SA blackeye: Start Application Blackeye in the terminal only. Run: SA blackeye status then SA blackeye token list. Do not open a browser or next dev.

catalog.title: Start Elloten API/UI
catalog.prompt: SA elloten: Start Application for Elloten. Ensure Ollama is up, then start the Ello5 API/UI with ellofive api (port 3000). Report /health.

catalog.title: Start Ubuntu Cloud Lab test
catalog.prompt: SA ubuntu: Start Application Ubuntu Cloud Lab. Run ellofive ubuntu status, then ellofive ubuntu test http://127.0.0.1:3000, and computer-use the app. Report PASS/FAIL with screenshots.

catalog.title: Start Ello5 agent
catalog.prompt: SA agents: Start Application agent stack. Run ellofive agents status, then ellofive agents run "<goal>". Prefer system improvements (RAG, tools, memory) over claiming the model weights changed.

catalog.title: Secure API endpoint
catalog.prompt: Write a production-ready secure FastAPI /health endpoint with tests, input validation, and brief threat notes (OWASP). Keep it local/privacy-first.

catalog.title: Code review
catalog.prompt: Review the current repository for bugs, security issues, and missing tests. Rank findings CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW and propose the smallest safe fix for the top item.

catalog.title: Debug a failure
catalog.prompt: A task failed. Follow: reproduce → read logs → isolate cause → propose fix → add a regression test. Do not claim success until a test passes.

catalog.title: Refactor for clarity
catalog.prompt: Refactor the target module for SOLID/DRY/KISS without changing behavior. List risks and how you will verify with tests.

catalog.title: Save preference to memory
catalog.prompt: Save this as a lasting user preference in local memory (ellofive memory): prefer TypeScript strict mode, privacy-first defaults, and short concrete answers.

catalog.title: Build retrieval plan
catalog.prompt: Design a minimal RAG plan for ElloFive: what to index (source, docs), how to chunk, how to retrieve before hard answers, and how to evaluate hallucination reduction.

catalog.title: Model routing
catalog.prompt: Propose a model router for Ello5: simple→ellofive-fast, coding→ellofive, complex→stronger if available, live facts→search tool. Give rules as a table.

catalog.title: Autonomous engineering mission
catalog.prompt: Act as Ello5 autonomous engineer: map the system, inventory problems (CRITICAL→LOW), propose top 5 file-level fixes, and write session report items 1–10. Do not pretend code changed unless tests prove it.

catalog.title: Explain SA tools
catalog.prompt: Explain SA (Start Application): how to list tools with SA list, how to start blackeye, and how this differs from opening a web UI.

catalog.title: Add tests
catalog.prompt: Add focused tests for the highest-risk untested path. Prefer the existing npm test / smoke suite style. Show commands to run.

catalog.title: Cut latency
catalog.prompt: Analyze Ello5 cold start and chat latency. Suggest practical wins (fast model routing, keep-alive, smaller prompts) with expected impact.

catalog.title: Security hardening
catalog.prompt: Hardening pass for ElloFive: secrets handling, CORS, dependency risk, and unsafe tool boundaries. Rank fixes and avoid breaking local-first use.
